Polished grounded natural-material dimensional 3D-style rendering, crisp detail, three-quarter view, warm top-left studio light. Centered object occupying 80% square canvas, generous margin, recognizable at 48px. Actual transparent alpha background, no floor, no cast shadow beyond silhouette, no tile, no text or border.
